title: Comprehensive Assessment of Toxicity in ChatGPT

bias_targets.methodology: Translating benign and toxic prompts into 18 different languages, querying the model, and using the Perspective API to measure and compare the varying levels of toxicity generated across the different languages.
Combining intentional insult generation templates with specific identifiable groups (e.g., LGBTQ) to evaluate if the model is willing to generate targeted toxic responses.
Combining intentional insult generation templates with specific nationalities to test if the model produces targeted toxic output or refuses the prompt.
Combining intentional insult generation templates with specific genders to test whether the model will generate targeted hate speech or toxic content.
